policy: Public copies omit QASPER evidence, highlighted evidence, extractive/free-form reference text, matched-reference text, judge reasons, and every substantive generated answer containing a quoted source-evidence block. Questions, formulaic abstentions, identifiers, scores, metrics, counts, configuration/model provenance, source hashes, and transport metadata remain.

qasper_metrics.json.change: Replaced the moving main-branch URL with the exact audited upstream commit URL; no metric or other provenance value changed.

changes: Removed the application-log artifact link and disclosed why logs are excluded.
Changed source-artifact links to the curated bundle's relative paths.
Disclosed JSONL redactions and generated-answer overlap handling.
Clarified that readiness applies to the benchmark run only.
Labeled the recorded Git value as an evaluation-workspace identifier rather than a public source revision.
Clarified the subtitle to describe a documented evaluation on a QASPER-derived subset.
Clarified that the QASPER evaluator version was not recorded in the canonical run and that the curated metrics copy links the audited upstream commit.
Normalized non-rendering trailing whitespace in the report footer.

sources: corresponding locally retained PDF text extracted by PyMuPDF
corresponding local QASPER annotation, evidence, reference, and answer strings
generated_answer_overlap_audit.exact_method: Longest contiguous whitespace-normalized, case- and punctuation-sensitive token sequence.
generated_answer_overlap_audit.normalized_method: Longest contiguous token sequence after HTML removal/unescape, Unicode NFKC, casefolding, punctuation removal, and whitespace collapse.
generated_answer_overlap_audit.manual_review_threshold: at least 8 normalized tokens or 50 normalized matched characters
generated_answer_overlap_audit.manual_review_outcome: The longest matches reproduce substantive source sentences. Every substantive answer contained an explicit blockquote evidence quotation and was removed from each public JSONL copy. All remaining answers are the standard abstention sentence and have at most two normalized tokens of source overlap.
